# Shallow Morphological Parsing (RT)

We want to include only data from `L2` `critical` trials.

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(brms)
```

## Summary measures:

First group by the columns we want then we can filter them.

```{r}
shallow <- read_csv("./data/song2020/shallow.csv")

#tibble

shallow |>
  group_by(Group, Critical_Filler) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(RT, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(
    Group == "L2",
    Critical_Filler == "Critical"
  )

#df

shallow_l2_critical <- shallow |>
  filter(
    Group == "L2",
    Critical_Filler == "Critical"
  )
```

> The mean reaction time of critical L2 participants is 967.75ms and the standard deviation is approximately 354.06ms.

## Plot

```{r}

shallow |>
  filter(
    Group == "L2", 
    Critical_Filler == "Critical"
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = RT)) +
  geom_density() +
  labs(
    x = "Reaction Time (ms)",
    y = "Density"
  )
  
```

## Model

We create the model with the mean and sd values we calculated:

```{r}
rt_brm <- brm(
  formula = RT ~ 1,
  family = gaussian,
  data = shallow_l2_critical
)
```

```{r}
summary(rt_brm)
```

quartiles

```{r}
quartiles <- qnorm(
  c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), 967.72, 354.30)

quartiles[3] - quartiles[1]
```

The IQR is 477.9434. This means that 50% of the density mass lies within approximately 729ms and 1207ms.

```{r}
plot(rt_brm, combo = c("dens", "trace"))
```
